text: The dentist is very lovely and speaks kindly. The reception staff also provided good service. I went for a teeth cleaning and to remove braces adhesive, and it wasn't painful at all. The dentist has a gentle touch. I experienced some tooth sensitivity, but it wasn't as severe as previous visits.

text:
Personally, I think the waiting time is quite long. It's not advisable to book an appointment for a day when you have other errands. I had a reservation and waited around 40-50 minutes, but I understand that it might have been a day with fewer doctors available.

The doctor was helpful and provided accurate and relevant information.
The scaling wasn't painful, but there was a slight stinging sensation when they held my mouth with their hand.
